summary: HealthKit is a shared store for health and fitness samples on iPhone and Apple Watch, with per-sample user permission. BifrOSt has no health data store and no app-facing API for it; the only health-like code is battery health in springboard/src/shell/battery.rs, which reads sysfs and is not related.

features.note: Apple health store tied to iPhone and Apple Watch sensors
Per-type read and share permission for health samples

features.apple: Saving data to HealthKit, Reading data from HealthKit
features.note: No sample types or queries in the SDK
Needs wearable input BifrOSt does not have
System health views with no BifrOSt counterpart

features.feature: Health app data merge and user control
features.note: Depends on the Apple Health app, which BifrOSt does not ship

gaps: No health data store, sample types or query API (n/a: tied to Apple health hardware and the Health app)
